title: Design, Supply, Installation, Testing, Commissioning and Operation including Post Warranty CAMC of Audio-Visual Projection Show system at Aguada Lighthouse, Goa.
summary: GeM two-cover (QCBS) tender for designing, supplying, installing and operating a laser projection-mapping audio-visual show on the Aguada Lighthouse tower and Inspection Quarter walls in Goa, with content creation, a control room cabin and UPS, one-year warranty and three years of post-warranty CAMC.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa

sites.name: Aguada Lighthouse & DGPS Station, Post Candolim, Sinquerim, Mapusa, North Goa 403515
sites.work: Audio-visual projection mapping show on two faces of lighthouse tower and one face of Inspection Quarter; control room, audio system, electrical works; operation and 3-year CAMC

scope.item: Part A 1.1: DLP laser phosphor multimedia projection system, min 9600 lm, 20000 hrs, 1920x1200 WUXGA, 4000000:1 contrast, HDBaseT, motorised focus/zoom, HDMI, DVI-D, 3D at 120 Hz, with mounting bracket, marine-grade enclosure and 0.37 UST lens (2 per wall, 3 walls)
Part A 1.2: G.I. poles for mounting projectors, 80 mm nominal dia C-class BIS G.I. pipe, min 4 m, with concrete foundation
Part A 1.3: Branded HDMI extender transmitter and receiver
Part A 1.4: Projection housing enclosure with control interface for temperature, humidity and status monitoring, locking bracket, fan
Part A 2.1: 2-way performance speakers, 1 inch tweeter + 8 inch LF, 70 W, 16 Ohm / 70-100 V (audio system for approx. 60 persons)
Part A 2.2: Audac SMQ500 quad channel power amplifier
Part A 2.3: Audac FX1.18 horn loaded 18 inch bass cabinet, 800 W RMS, IP55
Part A 2.4: Audac SMQ750 quad channel power amplifier
Part A 2.5: G.I. poles for mounting two speakers each, 80 mm C-class G.I. pipe, min 4 m, with concrete foundation
Part A 2.6: 1U 16-card-slot modular DSP (Xilica Solaro type) with Dante networked audio up to 64x64 channels
Part A 3: Show controller - projection mapping and content management software (edge blending, calibration) with master and slave rack servers, 27 inch HD monitor, licenses

Part A 4: Content generation - AV content with Fusion/Maya graphics, background score, voiceover, 20-30 min, local folk/folklore theme, English, Hindi and local language, 2D/3D animation, programming/integration

Part A 5: Electrical works - IP55/IP65 distribution boards and junction boxes (42 nos.), 8-way TPN MCB DB, 100 A isolator, MCBs, power/wiring points, LED battens, 2 TR split AC with stabilizer, GI pipe earthing (2 sets), FRLS wiring, CRCA cubical panel with MCCBs and 200 A bus bar, speaker/power/control cables
Part A 6: 15 ft x 8 ft prefabricated portable double-layer insulated control room cabin with aluminium doors and windows
Part A 7: Air conditioner for prefabricated portable cabin
Part A 8: 20 KVA online UPS, 3-phase in/out, IGBT, double conversion, isolation transformer, 30 minutes backup with trolley and rack
Part A 9: Skilled operator for regularly maintaining the equipment and operating the show throughout the year
Part B: Post warranty CAMC of the show system for 1st, 2nd and 3rd year

money.performance_security: 3% of Part A contract value, valid 3 months after 1-year warranty; plus 3% of Part B CAMC value (submitted one month before warranty expiry), valid 3 months after 3-year CAMC; BG or FDR
money.notes: Part A (design, supply, installation, testing, commissioning) Rs 3,44,85,500; Part B (3-year post warranty CAMC) Rs 1,03,45,650; total Rs 4,48,31,150 including GST. EMD by DD/FDR of nationalized bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa payable at Goa, by 30/09/2024, valid 90 days from publishing; MSE/NSIC exemption with bid security declaration (not for medium enterprises above Rs 50 crore turnover). Payment Part A 20% on supply, 40% on installation, 20% on acceptance, 20% after 180 days satisfactory working; Part B quarterly. Delay penalty 0.1% per day up to 5%; CAMC show disruption over 3 days 0.1% of CAMC cost per day up to 5% of annual CAMC value.

period.completion: 90 days from the date of award of contract
period.bid_validity: 90 days from the date of opening the bid
period.warranty: 1 year from acceptance, followed by 3-year post warranty CAMC

eligibility: Individual or JV/consortium of two parties, one with at least 5 years' experience designing AR experiences for public projects
Profitable company with minimum average turnover of INR 10 crore in last 5 financial years (technical evaluation references average annual turnover Rs 7.37 crore over FY 2021-22 to 2023-24)
At least one similar AR content work of INR 1.37 crore or more within last 5 years

Similar works for Govt of India/State Govts/PSUs/corporates in last seven years ending 31.08.2024: one >= Rs 2.76 crore (80%), or two >= Rs 2.07 crore (60%), or three >= Rs 1.37 crore (40%); similar work = design, SITC and operation incl. post warranty CAMC of (AR &) audio-visual projection show system
Not blacklisted by Central/State Govt; minimum 5 years similar service experience with OEM certification if not OEM; authorised partnership and warranty support agreement with AV hardware OEM
Only Class-I (>=50%) and Class-II (>20%) local suppliers

Technical documents: work orders/completion certificates, legal status, financial statements for 3 years, litigation disclosure, key personnel, ITRs FY 2021-22 to 2023-24, company registration, GST, make/model brochures, undertakings

Technical score minimum 70/100 (turnover 10, similar works 20, key personnel CVs 10, UNESCO heritage site immersive work 10, awards 10, creative presentation 40); final selection QCBS 70% technical / 30% financial
specs: Projection mapping on two faces of rectangular lighthouse tower and one face of Inspection Quarter; show duration 20-30 minutes; audio venue for approx. 60 persons
Equipment suitable for highly saline coastal environment; UG cables in 30-45 cm x 0.5 m trench with brick protection; copper FRLS wiring; works per Indian Electricity Act 2003 and Rules 1956
Named makes/models in BOQ: Audac SMQ500, Audac SMQ750 amplifiers, Audac FX1.18 bass cabinet, Xilica Solaro DSP
Hardware/software in use for at least 10 years; spares guaranteed 10 years; all content licenses and copyrights handed to DLL Goa
